health_is_zero.title: Silence
health_is_zero.narr_text: Your heart slows... blood pooling beneath you. No one comes...

900_screaming.title: A Quiet Conversation
900_screaming.narr_text: You scream for help, but only the sylphs answer—soft voices swirling through the air, murmuring in ancient tongues. They do not mock you. They mourn. Their whispers drift like wind through dying leaves, lamenting the loss of another flickering light swallowed by the dark. One more soul gone to the silence.

900_acceptance.title: Funny
900_acceptance.narr_text: Well, that went well. Another flawless victory… if by ‘flawless’ you mean 'completely disastrous.' I should probably make a note to self: dodge next time. Oh wait... that would have been useful, wouldn't it? Too bad I was too busy trying to be a hero. Guess I’ll try again... after, you know, the respawn.

900_fighton.title: A Quiet Defiance
900_fighton.narr_text: You scream for help, but only the sylphs answer—soft voices swirling through the air, murmuring in ancient tongues. They do not mock you. They mourn. Their whispers drift like wind through dying leaves, lamenting the loss of another flickering light swallowed by the dark. One more soul gone to the silence.

900_Loss.narr_text: Lycarus' vision fades, the edges of his world growing hazy as the whispers of the sylphs fill his mind. He feels the weight of their mourning, a sharp contrast to the cold emptiness that begins to encircle him.

900_thisis.narr_text: So, this is it. Another chapter closed, another warrior lost to the storm.' Lycarus thinks bitterly, his breath shallow. The sylphs' voices, soft and sorrowful, seem almost too gentle for the harsh reality of the world he fights to protect. He wonders for a moment if their sorrow is truly for him—or for the fate of humanity as a whole. Their eternal grief seems so... infinite.

600_flicker.narr_text: A flicker of defiance rises within him. Maybe he can't dodge the inevitable, but he won't go out quietly. If his last breath is to be a call to arms, then so be it.

1.text: Ask where the priest can be found.

900_mourning.title: Passing Dawn
900_mourning.narr_text: I can feel the warmth of the light calling me… my time has come. Forgive my failures, and remember the paths I walked. I let go now, into the darkness, and find peace at last.

900_Love.title: Echo of the Fall
900_Love.narr_text: As I rise into the golden light, a cold shiver snakes down my spine—familiar, like the instant I let go of life. Yet I do not fear it; it is merely a whisper of the path I have walked. I breathe it in, a quiet memory fading, and let the warmth of the heavens carry me onward, weightless and unafraid.

death_page.title: Field of Forgotten Echoes
death_page.narr_text: A dense, gray fog clings to the ground, weaving through jagged stones that jut up like tombstones from the barren earth. Whispers of forgotten lives drift with the mist, the restless sighs of souls tangled in the cold air. Shadows shift among the graves, and a weight presses on the chest, heavy and unyielding. Amid the spectral cries, a figure stands unseen yet undeniable. Its presence absolute and silent: it watches, waiting.
